spec: P5 (TLP baseline, secondary) -- docs/ext/tlp3.md section 3; replaces experiments/configs/ext_tlp2_p4h2.json + experiments/ext/tlp2/score.py (both must NOT be used for P4-H2)
registry_dependents_note: run_experiment.ext_methods() imports EVERY src/paper4/ext_*.py present at run time (bug E4). They do not compute any P5 method, but a later module could overwrite a method name or monkeypatch at import. preflight.py fails on a name collision and writes the sha256 of every loaded paper4 module (results/ext_tlp3_preflight/preflight.json); the lead should hash all ext_*.py present at run time together with the files above.
topology_bank: P4-H2 confirmatory; verified by sha256 inside topology.load_bank against the bank manifest (not read by tlp3)
commands: python3 experiments/ext/tlp3/preflight.py --out results/ext_tlp3_preflight/preflight.json   # must print ok: true, else do not run
run_order_note: Run after ext_v51_p4h2 (P1) if possible, so the descriptive v4-realisation check compares against P1's rows; the verdict does not depend on it.
expected_runtime_workers3: about 75.3 min (smoke extrapolation: 20 x 222 s main + ~77 s calibration); stated range 70-90 min; D-07 upper bound 87.8 min. Needs a user-approved exception to hard rule 5. Source: results/ext_tlp3_checks/runtime_estimate.json
rerun_policy: If interrupted before results/ext_tlp3_p4h2/runs.jsonl exists: rerun once, config unchanged, disclose. Never a cell-filter driver.
